answer: We construct a Sybil-resistant mechanism where identity validation requires committing dynamic opportunity-cost bonds verified by a zero-knowledge cipher across a staggered collateral terrace. Under a subgame-perfect punishment matrix, detected Sybil multiplication triggers instantaneous cross-collateral slashing, forcing adversarial payoff vectors into a catastrophic downward spiral. Because the net expected attack utility remains strictly negative, honest validation converges to a unique, dominant Nash equilibrium in adversarial multi-agent environments.
